question: criterion
claim: At size at least two, attainment requires an interior count and empirical variance strictly above binomial variance. At size one only mixed binary samples attain, on the empirical-proportion shape ray. At size zero all compatible samples attain.

question: failure
claim: For size at least two and an interior count with nonpositive dispersion excess, the binomial strictly wins. Constant endpoints have excluded point-mass suprema, and mixed endpoints have an excluded saturated two-point supremum. At size one only endpoint constants have excluded point-mass suprema. At size zero the compatible likelihood is flat and attained.

question: uniqueness
claim: On the capped size domain, constants and mixed zero-one data have the explicit maximizing sets in the source. On other attained samples compare the unique conditional candidates at each feasible size. For full support from zero through the sample maximum M, the saturation test gives a unique maximum when it passes. It always passes for M=2, passes for M=3 exactly when (n2/n1)^3=n3/n0, and detects rational-dispersion saturation at any M by the prime-exponent comparison.
frontier: Exact general free-dispersion height comparison and uncapped CMP-face equality remain open.

question: uniqueness
claim: Unique when attained for almost every sample on each fixed-count stratum with at least four levels or three equally replicated levels. One- and two-level samples never attain. In ordinary sample coordinates the result uses nonattainment at sizes one and two, equal counts at size three and at least four distinct levels almost everywhere at larger sizes. Not unique in general: with all coefficients free, one copy each of \(\pm 512\), 512 copies each of \(\pm 7/4\) and 5120 copies each of \(\pm 1\) have distinct reflected finite global maxima.
frontier: Formalize the three-equally-replicated-level width-score reconstruction and the digamma bound used at join contact and at two levels. Unequal three-level multiplicities and the number of reflected winning orbits remain open.

question: uniqueness
claim: Unique when a positive finite fit is attained for almost every sample on each fixed-count stratum with at least three levels when the held shape is neither 1 nor 2. The exact maximizing set at shape 1 or 2 is the whole support-compatible location interval when feasible. At lambda=-1 and sigma=1 the sample (-80/9,80/9) has reflected co-winners as well.
